sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 630117, captured 2026-10-12 (audit/state_park_fees/mt_sites_2026-10-12.json)

values.note: Only site 005 has hookups (50-amp electric and water); the other 17 sites have none. Electricity April - October.

hookups.source: https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/thompson-falls-state-park/r/campsiteDetails.do?siteId=33351&contractCode=MT&parkId=630117 (site 005 'Campsite Electric', 'Electricity Hookup: 50', 'Water Hookup: Y') + ReserveAmerica site list (every other campsite 'Electric Hookup - no', 'Full Hookup - no') + https://fwp.mt.gov/thompson-falls (Seasons & Hours: 'Electricity April - October'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP: 'maximum trailer length of 30 feet'. ReserveAmerica lists longer driveways at a few sites (pull-throughs 002 35 ft, 008 41 ft, 009 63 ft; electric site 005 60 ft) and short ones at others (003 and 006 18 ft, 001 20 ft).

sites.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/thompson-falls ('There are 18 campsites with a maximum trailer length of 30 feet.') + ReserveAmerica site list (002, 003, 004, 008, 009 Pull-Through), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Potable water May - September. Boat launch, fishing pond with accessible pier, picnic shelter, bear-resistant food lockers, camp host, firewood for sale.

facilities.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/thompson-falls (Amenities: 'Toilets (Vault)', 'Water', 'Boat Launch', 'Bear Resistant Storage Lockers', 'Camp Host', 'Firewood for Sale'; Seasons & Hours: 'Potable Water May - September'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/thompson-falls ('Reserve a Campsite', 'Reservation Phone Number: 1-855-922-6768') + https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/thompson-falls-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MT&parkId=630117 (Campsite and Campsite Electric: 'Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 3 Month(s) in advance.'), read 2026-10-22

note: MT FWP state park on the Clark Fork River near Thompson Falls: a shaded campground in mature mixed pine, with a family fishing pond and a riverside trail into town. --Claude
summary: FWP + ReserveAmerica: confirmed 18 sites, 50-amp electric (one site, 005, which also has water), reservable on ReserveAmerica (90-day window, 1-day cutoff now verified for this park). Changed max_rig_ft 63 -> 30 (FWP's stated trailer limit; RA's longer driveways noted). Added pull-throughs, water hookup at 005, vault toilets, seasonal potable water. Fees (FWP schedule, human) and season (manual) left; FWP says only 'Campsite fees range from $4-$34'. Note trimmed of restated values.
